datasets.name: Landslide inventory for Typhoon Morakot
datasets.verbatim: Landslide features were interpreted and verified by Mondini and Chang (2014) based on shapes, slopes, and textures.

datasets.name: 10-m digital elevation model (DEM)
datasets.verbatim: The used 10-m DEM was edited and verified by Chiang et al. (2012) based on a national airborne LiDAR project in Taiwan.

datasets.name: Stereo aerial images with a cell size of 0.5 m

methods.name: Unsupervised machine learning framework (k-means++, EM, and DBSCAN)
methods.summary: A framework using clustering algorithms (k-means++, EM, and DBSCAN) combined with 12 topographic and hydrological factors derived from a 10-m DEM to distinguish between landslide source and runout areas.
methods.source: Jhe-Syuan Lai, Jun-Yi Huang, Hong-Mao Huang & Yung-Chung Chuang
methods.verbatim: Therefore, this paper presents a framework involving the use of clustering analyses (i.e. k-means, expectation maximization, and DBSCAN) and landslide-related topographic factors to distinguish landslide sources from landslide-affected areas.

availability.author_statement: "The authors will supply the relevant data in response to reasonable requests.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and DEM are referenced but not linked, and the code is not available in any repository or persistent link.
